from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from services.db import connect
from services.calculations.health import recompute_health
from services.calculations.data_health import get_data_health

router = APIRouter(prefix="/overview")

@router.get("/data-health")
async def get_data_health_route():
    conn = connect()
    try:
        data_health = get_data_health(conn)
        return JSONResponse(content=data_health)
    finally:
        conn.close()

@router.get("/health")
async def get_health_route():
    conn = connect()
    try:
        data_health = get_data_health(conn)
        return JSONResponse(content=data_health)
    finally:
        conn.close()

@router.post("/recompute-health")
async def recompute_health_route():
    conn = connect()
    try:
        recompute_health(conn)
        data_health = get_data_health(conn)
        return JSONResponse(content=data_health)
    finally:
        conn.close()
